# CANDIDATE: VIX_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Sharp intraday VIX spikes (>1.8x 20-period ATR) often precede short-term mean-reversion in SPY as volatility contracts. When SPY pulls back to within 0.2% of VWAP during this spike with bullish momentum (close > open) and oversold RSI(<40), it offers a high-probability long entry opportunity. The edge exists because VIX mean-reversion tends to manifest in mid-morning (10:00-11:30 EST) after initial panic subsides, creating a VWAP-reversion long bias.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- VIX (1-min) > 1.8 × its 20-period ATR  
- SPY price pulls back to within 0.2% of VWAP  
- Bullish candle forms (close > open)  
- RSI(14) < 40  
- Time filter: 10:00-11:30 EST (avoid first 15 min after open)  
- Regime filter: VIX < 30 (avoid extreme panic)  
Enter long at close of the qualifying candle.

**Exit:**  
- Initial stop: Below the low of the pullback candle  
- Profit target: 1R (risk-reward = 1)  
- Optional runner: 50% position closed at 1R, remaining 50% trailed at 10% below highest high since entry (HWM)  
- Time stop: 15:50 ET (no 0DTE held into close)

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and min 3-contract floor.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest used BS-synthetic pricing over full 16-month SPY/VIX history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Sample size = 225 trades. High overfit risk due to no walk-forward/OOS validation; mechanism may not persist in changing volatility regimes.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS/WF test performed; requires Stage-2 backtest via autoresearch grinder harness).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (BS-synthetic pricing used; real OPRA fill validation pending).
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: 2025-Q1 (-$1300.50) from Stage-1 wide_pnl breakdown  
   - Max drawdown: $4,701.52 (from Stage-1 result)  
   - Blow-up scenario: Persistent VIX expansion (>30) with no mean-reversion (e.g., 2020 COVID crash) causing repeated stopouts  
   - Regime failure: Low-VIX trending markets (VIX <15) where pullbacks fail to reverse  
6. **Concentration:** Top 5 days = 999.0% of P&L (from Stage-1 result, indicating extreme concentration; requires further analysis to confirm).
